Trust · What to check

Why Accreditations Matter for Your Safety

China’s Grade III Class A (3A) public medical centers represent the highest level of the national hospital rating system. Their designation reflects formal assessment of clinical capability, safety protocols, infection control and hospital governance. These leading centers bring together renowned specialists, advanced medical resources and rigorous clinical standards, offering patients access to highly professional, authoritative care in China.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Answers before you travel.

Everything you need to know about planning your care journey in Shanghai — from bespoke itineraries and language support to trusted hospital selection.

How are your coordination fees structured?

We believe in upfront transparency with zero hidden surprises. Our coordination services are available as flexible à la carte options or comprehensive multi-day care packages tailored to your itinerary. Before you make any commitment, we provide a detailed written proposal outlining your exact concierge fees, while all hospital clinical charges remain billed directly and transparently by the healthcare facility.

Do I need to speak Chinese to navigate care?

Not at all. Your dedicated care coordinator provides professional bilingual medical interpretation and bedside escort throughout your entire journey — from doctor consultations to diagnostic tests. Additionally, the international wings of our partner hospitals are staffed with fluent English-speaking clinical teams, with Japanese and other languages readily available upon request.

How far in advance should I plan my visit?

We generally recommend reaching out 1 to 2 weeks prior to your desired travel dates to ensure optimal physician availability and seamless itinerary planning. However, for time-sensitive treatments or urgent specialist consultations, our direct green channels allow us to fast-track appointments within a matter of days.

What is included in your care coordination?

We deliver comprehensive, end-to-end guidance customized to your needs. This typically covers priority specialist scheduling, certified medical records synthesis, on-site bilingual hospital escort, VIP airport transfers, accommodation assistance, and systematic handover of all your clinical reports and post-care guidelines.

How do you help me select the right hospital or specialist?

We carefully assess your medical priorities, personal preferences, and travel timeline to match you with Shanghai’s premier Grade 3A academic centers or internationally accredited private hospitals. We provide clear, objective profiles of leading department heads and clinical facilities, empowering you to choose with total clarity and confidence.

Can I book a hospital checkup under China’s 240-hour transit visa-free or 30-day visa-free policy?

Yes. International travelers entering Shanghai under the 30-day visa-free policy or the 240-hour (10-day) transit visa-free policy can register at our partner hospitals using their original physical passport. Our team completes your pre-visit passport registration in advance so you can complete a comprehensive checkup or TCM visit within 1 to 2 days.

How do I pay the hospital, and what cards are accepted?

You pay all medical and examination charges directly at the hospital’s International Medical Department VIP counter. No clinical markup is ever added by Yulana Health. Major international credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), Alipay/WeChat Pay (linked to foreign cards), RMB cash, and approved international insurance direct billing (GOP) are accepted.

Will I receive English medical reports and imaging files to show my doctor back home?

Yes. Alongside the hospital’s official diagnostic reports and digital imaging files (DICOM/cloud links or films for MRI and CT), Yulana Health prepares a structured English Executive Medical Summary within 48 hours so your home physician can review your results effortlessly.

Booking notes

What happens after you enquire?

Is my visit confirmed when I submit the form?

Not immediately. Submitting the form allows us to review your initial details. A dedicated care coordinator will then reach out to better understand your specific health needs and preferences. Once we align on your care plan, we will coordinate directly with the provider, and your appointment will be officially confirmed once finalized by the medical team.

Do I need a doctor's appointment before screening or imaging?

It varies by service, but we’ll take care of the coordination for you. Many health checks can be booked directly, while advanced scans may require physician review to guarantee clinical precision. Our care team will confirm the exact steps with the medical facility and ensure everything is smoothly arranged for your visit.

Can I send my records now?

There is no need to send them just yet — your privacy is our top priority. Once we understand your specific care needs and align with the hospital medical team, we will guide you on exactly which records are needed. We will provide a secure, confidential channel to collect your documents safely and handle them with the utmost professional care.

Frequently asked questions

Good to know.

Clear guidance for a seamless experience. If you need clarity on a specific hospital, physician, or insurance policy, our team will personally verify every detail for you.

Do you provide medical advice or treatment?

All medical diagnoses, clinical evaluations, and treatment plans are exclusively provided by licensed physicians at our accredited partner hospitals. Yulana Health serves as your professional care coordinator and medical concierge — handling hospital matching, appointment scheduling, bilingual clinical interpretation, and end-to-end on-site guidance so you can focus entirely on your health.

Can my international insurance cover my visit directly?

Yes, many leading hospitals in our network support direct billing with major international insurers and TPAs. We actively assist you as a bridge — liaising directly with your insurance provider and the hospital's international medical department to facilitate policy verification, pre-authorization, and Guarantee of Payment (GOP) for a seamless, cashless visit.

Can you arrange urgent or short-notice appointments?

For expedited clinical visits or fast-tracked specialist consultations, our coordination team can often secure priority appointment slots within 24–48 hours depending on hospital capacity. However, please note that we do not handle acute, life-threatening emergencies. In case of an immediate medical emergency, please dial 120 or visit the nearest hospital emergency department directly.
